name: PWA shell, manifest, and service worker
probe: GET /, GET /manifest.webmanifest, GET /sw.js return HTTP 200 and register Workbox service worker

name: Protected BFF auth guard (401/403)
probe: Unauthenticated, malformed, invalid-token, or non-ALLOWED_UID calls to GET /api/auth/session and POST /api/ai/* return HTTP 401/403 JSON with zero Vertex AI invocations

name: SPA client route fallback vs API 404 JSON
probe: GET /analytics, /plan, /library, /in-gym, /start, /sessions/:id return 200 index.html; unknown /api/* returns 404 JSON

name: Single-UID Auth gate
probe: 390x844 mobile viewport renders sign-in gate when unauthenticated, rejects non-ALLOWED_UID, and enters authenticated shell for ALLOWED_UID

name: 66-exercise seed + custom Library CRUD
probe: Seeds 66 default exercises on first load and supports creating, editing, searching, and deleting custom exercises in Library

name: Plan & PlanDay ordering and targets
probe: Creates/edits workout plan and plan days, adds/reorders/removes exercises, and persists target sets/reps/weight

name: InGym active session set logging
probe: Starts active workout session, logs sets with weight/reps, supports mid-workout exercise/set add-remove and serialized sessionShadow writes

name: Reload-persistent sticky top RestBar clock
probe: Completing a set starts sticky top RestBar count-up timer persisted in sessionStorage that survives route navigation and page reload

name: Last-3-executions progressive overload display
probe: Active workout inline history displays weights and reps from the last 3 completed sessions for each exercise

name: Analytics charts (React.lazy)
probe: Renders lazy-loaded Analytics volume/progression charts from completed sessions without errors

name: SessionDetail view
probe: Opens completed workout session detail and displays logged exercises, sets, weights, reps, and timestamps

name: Modular anti-monolith and ASD-STE100 compliance
probe: Entrypoints <=200 lines, modules <=300 lines, zero import cycles, and Why-focused ASD-STE100 module header docstrings

name: Bundle secret scan & Firestore DB isolation
probe: Zero GCP/Vertex secrets or SDKs in client bundles; firestore.rules and composite indexes deployed to isolated marombapp DB enforcing single ALLOWED_UID

name: Zero unrequested AI UI or behavioral regression
probe: Zero speculative AI screens/buttons prior to PO issues; offline persistentLocalCache + persistentMultipleTabManager preserved

name: Cloud Run BFF latency SLO
probe: N=50 timed requests after warmup satisfy p50 <= 80ms, p95 <= 250ms, p99 <= 500ms
